name: EmailRep.io e-mail reputation API (keyed)
tier_rationale: Established US security company with a business offering (A8 trusted): 'Sublime Security: tier trusted.' (P089 chair rationale). Its terms were not reachable on 2026-11-26, so the source terms are 'unknown' and the module stays disabled in every profile until legal records them (P089 cond 1).

reliability.justification: Reputation verdicts and first/last-seen dates aggregated by the provider from its own sources; flags are signals, never proof (P089).

emailrep.description: EmailRep API key (sent only in the 'Key' header; the anonymous API is disabled: HTTP 429)
emailrep.plan_hint: terms unknown today: the module never runs (A1) until legal records the EmailRep terms; afterwards key-terms with a company account and a recorded plan (P089 cond 1)

reputation.title: EmailRep reputation of one address (GET https://emailrep.io/{email}, headers Key + Accept: application/json)

terms.quote: Terms: EmailRep (Sublime Security, US) terms were not reachable on 2026-11-26, so the source is 'unknown' and stays disabled in every profile until legal records them (A1).

reputation.notes: Research C0206 (verified_needs_key: 401/200/429). Without Accept: application/json the URL serves the HTML site with HTTP 200 (error marker emailrep_html_page); an invalid key gives 401 {status: fail, reason: 'invalid api key'} -> NEEDS_KEY; anonymous or throttled 429 -> RATE_LIMITED (P089 cond 3). The full address is disclosed to the provider: reuses_queries=true (fail closed, P089 cond 2), so the policy gate skips it at TLP:AMBER and above; analyst-typed seeds only; the recipient is recorded in the ROPA. 'deliverable', 'accept_all' (provider-side SMTP verification) and 'profiles' (server-side account checks) are dropped at ingestion (P089 cond 4); the HTTP cache never stores the answer (ttl 0, no-store), so the raw body with those fields is never written anywhere. The free-key quota is unpublished: the daily block (10, published false) is a placeholder until the team plan is recorded (P334). Used by emailrep.

notes: Owned by batch p3-G04-1 (P089 emailrep). Not flagged sensitive: the answer carries reputation flags (including a 'credentials leaked' boolean), never breach records, and it is never cached; the module keeps the P089 cond 5 allow-list only.
